summary: Network connection thread entry. Dispatches a virtual thread-init callback, initializes Winsock, drains and destroys a linked list of pending objects under mutex, signals a readiness flag under a second mutex, creates TCP and UDP sockets, configures both via TCPSocketInit, then marks the thread ready. Returns 0 on success, otherwise 6.
